items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: All I can remember is I first met Betty Carter there.

ctx.x: Was there evidence of Betty Carter or whatever her name was at that time?
Anna May [Lillie Mae Jones], whatever her last name was.

items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: At that time she was Betty Bebop with Lionel Hampton, I think.

ctx.x: Anna May [Lillie Mae Jones], whatever her last name was.

At that time she was Betty Bebop with Lionel Hampton, I think. But all these musicians. I thought wow, man, there’s so many musicians in Detroit, so much happening, so many clubs on the west side, on the east end, and on the north side.
